title: Monitoring costs with Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor and AWS Budgets [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this, your hands-on tutorial on monitoring your machine learning costs.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，歡迎來到這堂監控機器學習成本的實作教學。

cues.en: So there are three services that allow you to do this, and which you must remember for the exam, which are, first, Cost Explorer, second, Trusted Advisor,
cues.zh: 有三個服務可以做到，考試一定要記住：第一個是 Cost Explorer，第二個是 Trusted Advisor，

cues.en: which will actually act more like an advisor to help you reduce and minimize your cost, and AWS Budget, okay?
cues.zh: 它比較像顧問，協助你降低並盡量減少成本；第三個是 AWS Budgets。

cues.en: So let me just show you quickly these three services.
cues.zh: 我快速示範這三個服務。

cues.en: Of course, here, I'm on the same account on which we've developed and deployed all our machinery models of this course and therefore, you will see a lot of costs
cues.zh: 目前登入的，當然還是我們在這門課開發與部署所有機器學習模型的同一個帳戶，因此會看到很多費用，

cues.en: related to SageMaker, which is good, but don't worry, my costs are actually much higher than yours because, you know, in order to prepare the tutorials, I did a lot of experimentation in the services,
cues.zh: 都和 SageMaker 有關，這很好。不過別擔心，我的費用其實比你的高很多，因為準備教學時，我在各項服務中做了大量實驗，

cues.en: especially SageMaker, okay?
cues.zh: 尤其是 SageMaker。

cues.en: So no worries about the cost you're about to see, just wanted to give you a heads up.
cues.zh: 所以別被接下來的費用嚇到，先提醒你一下。

cues.en: All right, so the first one is Cost Explorer, all right?
cues.zh: 好，第一個是 Cost Explorer。

cues.en: Cost Explorer, billing and cost management feature, here we go.
cues.zh: Cost Explorer，是 Billing and Cost Management 的功能，進入這裡。

cues.en: Welcome to Cost Explorer.
cues.zh: 歡迎使用 Cost Explorer。

cues.en: And there we go, it actually takes us directly to the new cost and usage report and, yes, there we go, that's my total cost of actually just making the course, and notice once again, it's because I did a lot
cues.zh: 它直接帶我們進入新的成本與用量報告。這就是我製作這門課的總費用。再強調一次，是因為我做了很多實驗，

cues.en: of experimentation in order to prepare the hands-on tutorials, all right?
cues.zh: 用來準備實作教學。

cues.en: But there you go, that's how it works.
cues.zh: 它的運作方式就是這樣。

cues.en: This is the total cost for this date range from 1st of May 2025 to 31st of October 2025.
cues.zh: 這是 2025 年 5 月 1 日至 2025 年 10 月 31 日期間的總費用。

cues.en: This is my average monthly cost, which is not too bad with all the experimentation I did.
cues.zh: 這是平均每月費用；考量我做過的所有實驗，還算不錯。

cues.en: Here, you have the cost and usage graph report telling you for each month the monthly cost.
cues.zh: 這裡有成本與用量圖表報告，顯示每個月的費用。

cues.en: So actually, indeed, I started creating the CMLE course in September 2025, and my cost for September was $178.47, okay?
cues.zh: 我其實在 2025 年 9 月開始製作 CMLE 課程，九月的費用是 178.47 美元。

cues.en: And then in October, while we did some deployment, deployment is actually expensive, so my total cost was $252.68, okay?
cues.zh: 十月做了一些部署，而部署其實很昂貴，所以總費用是 252.68 美元。

cues.en: Which is why the cleanup is extremely important to do in SageMaker.
cues.zh: 因此，在 SageMaker 完成清理非常重要。

cues.en: And if we scroll down more, we can see the cost and usage breakdown, okay?
cues.zh: 再往下捲，可以看到成本與用量明細。

cues.en: So once again, this is my total cost for this same period and this is the SageMaker cost, of course, that represents the major part of the cost, tax, CloudWatch,
cues.zh: 這同樣是這段期間的總費用，這裡是 SageMaker 費用，當然占最大部分；還有稅金、CloudWatch，

cues.en: we did a bit of CloudWatch as well, and there you go, okay?
cues.zh: 我們也用了一些 CloudWatch，就是這樣。

cues.en: So you have all the other services here which cost nothing, okay?
cues.zh: 其他服務列在這裡，都沒有費用。

cues.en: So that's Cost Explorer.
cues.zh: 這就是 Cost Explorer。

cues.en: Now, let me show you the second one, which is Trusted Advisor, okay?
cues.zh: 接著示範第二個 Trusted Advisor。

cues.en: Trusted Advisor, remember this for the exam, optimize performance, improve security, and reduce costs.
cues.zh: Trusted Advisor，考試要記住：最佳化效能、改善安全性，以及降低成本。

cues.en: So Trusted Advisor acts more like an advisor, which will help you reduce your cost, not really monitor your cost as it is, okay?
cues.zh: Trusted Advisor 比較像顧問，協助降低費用，而不是直接監控費用。

cues.en: It's with Cost Explorer.
cues.zh: 監控費用是 Cost Explorer 的工作。

cues.en: So let's go to Trusted Advisor, and you will see that you can not only get some help to reduce the cost, but also improve the performance,
cues.zh: 進入 Trusted Advisor。你會看到，它不只協助降低成本，還能改善效能，

cues.en: improve the security, fault tolerance, service limits, operational excellence, okay?
cues.zh: 以及安全性、容錯能力、服務限制和營運卓越。

cues.en: So it provides indeed recommendations for these six pillars.
cues.zh: 它會針對這六大支柱提供建議。

cues.en: And so if we go to cost optimization, because that's the topic of this tutorial, well, yes, indeed, you have to upgrade your AWS support plan to get all Trusted Advisor checks including the ones for cost optimization.
cues.zh: 這堂教學的主題是成本，所以進入 Cost optimization。你必須升級 AWS 支援方案，才能取得所有 Trusted Advisor 檢查，包括成本最佳化檢查。

cues.en: So we could actually not use this, but there you go.
cues.zh: 所以我們其實無法使用這個功能，不過看到了。

cues.en: What you need to remember is that Trusted Advisor can provide recommendations to optimize the cost of your machinery models development or deployment
cues.zh: 你需要記住，Trusted Advisor 可提供建議，最佳化機器學習模型開發或部署的成本，

cues.en: or your machine learning infrastructures, all right?
cues.zh: 或機器學習基礎設施的成本。

cues.en: And finally, the last one, Budgets, all right?
cues.zh: 最後一個是 Budgets。

cues.en: Which is a feature actually not a service in billing and cost management, okay?
cues.zh: 它其實是 Billing and Cost Management 中的功能，而非獨立服務。

cues.en: It's a feature that you will find your billing and cost management, which you can find here as well, right?
cues.zh: 你會在 Billing and Cost Management 裡找到它，也可以從這裡進入。

cues.en: Billing and cost management.
cues.zh: 帳單與成本管理。

cues.en: Okay, so Budget, let's go to Budgets.
cues.zh: 好，前往 Budgets。

cues.en: All right, welcome to AWS Budgets, there we go.
cues.zh: 歡迎使用 AWS Budgets，就在這裡。

cues.en: It seems to be a service here, but it's actually in billing and cost management.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來像一項服務，但其實位於 Billing and Cost Management 之中。

cues.en: Set custom budgets that alert you when you exceed your budgeted threshold.
cues.zh: 設定自訂預算，超過預算門檻時就會通知你。

cues.en: Remember when we created that billing alarm?
cues.zh: 記得我們之前建立過帳單警示嗎？

cues.en: Well, that's a bit similar here.
cues.zh: 這裡有點類似。

cues.en: AWS Budgets is your hub for creating, tracking, and inspecting your budgets.
cues.zh: AWS Budgets 是建立、追蹤與檢視預算的中心。

cues.en: Do you want to create a budget super quickly without creating it at the end?
cues.zh: 要不要快速看看如何建立預算？最後不會真的建立，

cues.en: But just to show you the setup.
cues.zh: 只是示範設定方式。

cues.en: So first, you can use either a template or fully customize it.
cues.zh: 首先，可以使用範本，也可以完全自訂。

cues.en: So we'll choose a template, that's the simplest solution.
cues.zh: 我們選範本，這是最簡單的方式。

cues.en: Then speaking of template, which is new by the way, you have the choice between zero spend budget where you don't want to take any risk with your money,
cues.zh: 說到範本，順帶一提，這是新功能。可以選 Zero spend budget，也就是不想在費用上冒任何風險，

cues.en: you know, it will notify you if your cost exceeds $0.01.
cues.zh: 只要費用超過 0.01 美元就通知你。

cues.en: Monthly cost budget, you can define a budget you don't want to exceed per month.
cues.zh: Monthly cost budget，設定每個月不希望超過的預算。

cues.en: Daily savings plan covering budget and daily reservation utilization budget, okay?
cues.zh: 還有每日 Savings Plans 涵蓋率預算，以及每日預留執行個體使用率預算。

cues.en: So well, let's go for this one even though it's a bit difficult to do a zero spend budget when you do machine learning in AWS.
cues.zh: 先選這個；雖然在 AWS 做機器學習，要維持零支出有點困難。

cues.en: Zero spend budget template, and there you go, you see it's very easy.
cues.zh: Zero spend budget 範本，你看，非常簡單。

cues.en: And if we take the more realistic one monthly cost budget, of course, we will specify the budgeted amount that you don't want to exceed each month right here.
cues.zh: 如果選比較實際的 Monthly cost budget，當然要在這裡指定每個月不想超過的預算金額。

cues.en: And $100 is indeed much more realistic when you do machine learning in AWS.
cues.zh: 在 AWS 做機器學習時，100 美元確實比較實際。

cues.en: Email recipient, that's where you wanna be notified.
cues.zh: Email recipients，就是要接收通知的地址。

cues.en: So you can enter some email addresses here to get the email notifications and the scope, okay?
cues.zh: 在這裡輸入電子郵件地址，接收郵件通知，並設定範圍。

cues.en: And then you click Create Budget, but I won't to here.
cues.zh: 最後按 Create budget，但我這裡不會真的建立。

cues.en: We are actually at the end of this Certified Machine Learning Engineer course, so it would be a bit stupid to set up a budget now.
cues.zh: 這門 Certified Machine Learning Engineer 課程其實已經接近尾聲，現在才設定預算有點沒意義。

cues.en: But we did set up the billing alarm at the beginning of this course, which was already useful enough.
cues.zh: 不過我們在課程一開始已設定帳單警示，就已經相當有用了。

cues.en: All right, so there you go, that's what you need to remember for any machine learning cost related questions at the exam.
cues.zh: 這些就是考試遇到機器學習成本相關問題時，需要記住的內容。

cues.en: Now, I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial, and until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 期待在下一堂實作教學再見到你。在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
